label: Fretformer v1 (ONNX)
note: Full ONNX generator: Demucs separation + Beat This timing + transcriber (mel features, encoder, CFG autoregressive decoder) + token->notes.chart writer.

demucs_analysis_stft.description: Demucs HTDemucs analysis STFT (Conv1d complex STFT). Reflect-padded stereo mix flattened to (2, padded_L) -> real/imag spectrograms.

demucs_core_network.description: Demucs HTDemucs core network (manual-attention encoder/decoder + cross transformer). Only numerically correct at the trace time axis.

demucs_synthesis_istft.description: Demucs HTDemucs synthesis ISTFT (ConvTranspose1d weighted overlap-add). Nyquist bin restored + 2-frame time pad before this graph.

beat_this_mel.description: Beat This log-mel spectrogram frontend (torchaudio MelSpectrogram n_fft=1024 hop=441 f_min=30 f_max=11000 n_mels=128 slaney power=1 normalized=frame_length + log1p(1000*m)). mono 22050 Hz wav -> [n_frames, 128] (time x bins).

beat_this_core.description: Fine-tuned Beat This core (val beat F=0.9082) beat+downbeat logit head, traced at chunk_size=1500 frames (50 fps). Only numerically valid at exactly 1500 frames.

transcriber_mel.description: Transcriber mel frontend (librosa-style log-mel dB, n_fft=2048 hop=512 n_mels=80 fmin=0 fmax=11025 slaney power=2 center=True pad_mode=constant absolute dB ref=1.0). mono 22050 Hz wav -> mel_db[80, n_frames] (bins x time). The graph outputs ABSOLUTE dB; the app-side shared-dB-reference + normalize steps (see stages.transcriber.sharedDbReference and normalizeMelDb) must be applied BEFORE beatMelWindows.

transcriber_encoder.description: Fretformer v1 encoder. Beat-mel [1,n_beats,5,80,32] + mask [1,n_beats] -> cross-attention KV cache (cross_k/cross_v (10,8,n_beats,64)), aligned_memory (n_beats,512), mem_invalid (1,1,n_beats).

transcriber_decoder_step.description: Fretformer v1 single-step decoder (10 layers, 8 heads, head_dim=64, d_model=512, vocab=150). One autoregressive step: token_id+step_id+beat_idx -> logits + appended self-attention K/V cache row. Two-call CFG is the (parity-validated) naive orchestration; batched-CFG is a follow-up speed optimization.

demucs.safety: The core network is only numerically correct at exactly 343980 samples / 336 frames. Assert the padded segment length equals 343980 before every core call; off-shape inference silently corrupts output.
demucs.accuracy: Validated at 77.6 dB mean SDR against the reference PyTorch Demucs implementation.

beat.safety: The beat core ONNX is only numerically valid at exactly 1500 mel frames. Assert the chunk mel length equals 1500 before every core call; off-shape inference silently corrupts output. The full split -> aggregate -> minimal postproc -> smoother chain mirrors upstream beat_this.inference.split_predict_aggregate + Postprocessor(type="minimal", fps=50) followed by the timing smoother.
beat.accuracy: Validated against the upstream Python library + reference smoother (same mel+core fp32 graphs, same mono 22050 Hz decoded wav; PASS bar: same beat/downbeat counts and max|Δ| ≤ 1e-3 s on raw + smoothed beats and downbeats).

transcriber.sharedDbReference: ref_db = max over all 6 channels { max_{t,mel} mel_db_abs_c[t,mel] }; mel_db_shared_c = mel_db_abs_c - ref_db
transcriber.nonDrumsMix: bass + vocals + other (elementwise mono 22050); mel only used to compute the shared dB ref; NOT fed to the encoder.
transcriber.beatMelWindows: For each beat i in [0,n_beats): sample 32 points at t_i + (j+0.5)/32 * (t_{i+1}-t_i) for j in [0,32). Convert to fractional frame index = time / (512/22050); idx0=floor clipped to [0,n_frames-1]; idx1=idx0+1 clamped to [0,n_frames-1]; linearly interpolate out[m,j] = mel[m,idx0]*(1-frac) + mel[m,idx1]*frac. Result per channel: (80,32). Stack 5 channels -> (n_beats,5,80,32) -> (1,n_beats,5,80,32).
transcriber.nBeatsDetermination: From beatThis smoothed grid + nLeadIn prepended; n_beats = len(beatTimes)-1, capped so beatTimes[n_beats] <= audioDuration and to model_config.max_beats (1280).

prefixConditioning.loader: engine/lib/onnx/prefixTables.cjs (tiny pure-JS npz/npy reader; no Python at runtime)
prefixConditioning.lookupRule: For each knob k in [0,5): scan first 8 prefix tokens for one in [DESC_BASE + k*8, DESC_BASE + k*8 + 8); if found, bin_id = tok - base, else bin_id = 7 (auto). prefix_bias += desc_tables[k][bin_id]. difficulty embedding is NOT applied (pervasive_difficulty=false).

transcriber.safety: Encoder must receive beat_mel as NORMALIZED [-1,1] values (after shared-dB-reference subtraction + normalize_mel_db), NOT raw dB. The mel graph outputs ABSOLUTE dB; failing the shared reference or the normalize produces a constant affine offset per song that the encoder is NOT trained to tolerate. CFG MUST be the naive 2-call shape (cond + uncond, guided = uncond + w*(cond-uncond), then sample/argmax on guided) -- batched-CFG is NOT validated for parity.
transcriber.accuracy: Decode loop (CFG + greedy) validated token-identical to the reference implementation at temperature 0 with the same beat_mel/prefix_tokens/prefix_bias; ongoing gate engine/test/transcribe-cfg-batch-parity.cjs.

transcriber_reference_manifest.note: Exporter manifest kept alongside the graphs as transcriber_manifest.json; any model_config / vocab / prefix_conditioning change here must stay in sync.
